examples.description: An attacker exploits a vulnerable search input field by injecting a UNION-based SQL payload to extract usernames and password hashes from the users table.
examples.injection_payload: ' UNION SELECT username, password FROM users--
indicators: Presence of UNION SELECT in the query string
Unexpected columns returned in search results
Database error messages revealing query structure
Unusual increase in database response time

examples.description: An attacker uses a UNION-based SQL injection on a product ID parameter to retrieve credit card numbers stored in a separate payments table.
examples.injection_payload: 1 UNION SELECT card_number, expiration_date FROM payments--
indicators: SQL queries combining data from products and payments tables
Unexpected data fields in product details response
Suspicious patterns in database logs showing UNION with payments table
Alerts from database monitoring tools on cross-table queries

examples.description: Automated scanner attempts UNION-based SQL injection on a user profile endpoint to enumerate database schema information.
examples.injection_payload: ' UNION SELECT null, table_name FROM information_schema.tables--
examples.impact: Reconnaissance to map database structure for further exploitation
indicators: Repeated injection attempts with UNION SELECT patterns
Database logs showing access to metadata tables
High volume of failed or anomalous queries targeting same endpoint
